description: Rave hoover riff in A minor at 160 BPM: power chords on the wide detuned hoover with its fast pitch dive and wobble.
Uplifting trance melody in A minor at 138 BPM built from long notes: it starts sparse, thickens with octaves, runs up and holds the peak.
Slow, wide analog style pad chords, no effects needed.
Rhythmic house chord melody on organ at 124 BPM: the chord changes every two beats (Cmaj7, Em7, Am7, Fmaj7, Dm7, G7sus, G7) with syncopated stabs and early pushes.
Rolling offbeat trance bass on A, F, C and G.
